questions.q: The script arms the vehicle, but it doesn't arm. In the tlog:
questions.fragment:
> COMMAND_LONG  command=400 (ARM_DISARM) param1=1 confirmation=0
< COMMAND_ACK   command=400 result=4 (FAILED)
< STATUSTEXT    severity=2 text="PreArm: Battery 1 below minimum arming voltage"
options: The command was rejected by a pre-arm check: the reason is in STATUSTEXT — voltage below the arming threshold
The script didn't wait for the ACK: result=4 means “in progress,” you need to wait longer
You need to retry with confirmation=1 — without it ArduPilot always rejects the first arming attempt
Wrong command number: arming is MAV_CMD_DO_SET_MODE, not 400
questions.explain: result=4 is a failure; the reason comes separately in STATUSTEXT. Retrying won't help.
